verdicts.reason: A is basically a shrunk copy of the original. The headline, CTA and especially the long single-line subtitle are undersized, there is about 140px of empty space below the CTA, and the content block sits high, so the canvas feels unbalanced. B uses the portrait shape better: the can and headline are bigger, the subtitle wraps neatly onto two lines, and the CTA has real weight. Its flaws are a cramped gap between the subtitle and the CTA (smaller than the other gaps) and a headline that runs close to the side edges.
